description_en: Create an agent account in the Cloud Customer Service System and return the agent ID.
description_zh: 创建悉犀客服工作台坐席账号，并返回坐席ID
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs create-agent --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --display-name 'XX测试' --skill-group-id 12340000 --skill-group-id-list 1223000014560000 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAgent

parameters.help_en: Unique ID of the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. It can be generated using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview).
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. It is unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: ID of the skill group to which the agent belongs.
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: List of skill group IDs to which the agent belongs
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list
